column1: # The divergences the macro is to blame for. A line names a pattern in id
# syntax, whose unnamed axes are free and whose named values may be
# neutral; a finding as an outcome spells it; and one sentence saying what
# is wrong. A cell that diverges is excused when every finding that makes
# it diverge is excused by a line whose pattern matches it. A line that
# excuses no finding in a complete run fails the run as stale. Columns are
# separated by one tab.
# A mark, or a method a partial block writes, under the trait method's own
# `#[cfg]`: the builds the mark leaves to the plain forwarding are none
# where the method exists, yet the variant it cannot reach is reported.
item=cfg-on s1=unit
column3: A partial block's mark or method under the trait method's own `#[cfg]` gets the sentence of a variant it leaves out, as though the method were forwarded to every variant in the builds where the method exists.
